**Location Spoofer Browser Edition {VERSION}** — the edition that runs in your web browser, built on pymobiledevice3. Use it if you need iOS 17.0–17.3 support or the pymobiledevice3 command fallback; otherwise the native Windows app is recommended.{CHANNEL_NOTE}

### Install
1. Install **Apple Devices** from the Microsoft Store (or iTunes).
2. Download **`LocationSpooferBrowser.exe`** below and save it in a folder you own.
3. Run it. A console window opens (closing it quits the app) and the app opens in your web browser. If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", choose **More info → Run anyway**.

Already installed? The app updates itself; press **Restart now** when it offers.
